# A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A01′ — Faithful Definition of the Agent](conjugate/A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The one asking what the Subject is is already present in the asking. A thought can appear, a self-image can change, and an account of the mind can be examined; the appearing of any of these is already given to the one undertaking the examination. The Subject is this immediate pole of the inquiry. Adding another image to the account does not place that pole among its contents.

Definition is an act of determination: it distinguishes, excludes, relates and lets consequences follow. Its clarity depends on giving a term a place within a field of intelligibility. When the term names the Subject, or when *God* names the source and condition of a world, this power meets its own condition. It can represent what makes determination possible, but that representation is itself a determination. Treating it as exhaustive would install the determining condition as one more determined occupant of the field.

**A definition is faithful when its own determining act remains visible inside the account it gives.** It makes a positive claim and remains answerable for it. Its finitude does not make it false. It becomes unfaithful when the achieved boundary is treated as possession of the source from which boundary-making is possible. [Faithful Definition](concepts/C02-Faithful-Definition.md) keeps the definite claim answerable to its referent; [Subject / Defined Indefinability](concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) preserves the difference between the presence through which an account is given and the account itself.

The Subject is *definedly indefinable*. This identifies the precise office that an exhaustive description cannot occupy. It does not shelter a hidden substance behind appearances. Nor does it leave the God-term indeterminate: a word that discriminates nothing cannot distinguish a source from another projection. The definition must therefore be attempted. Its fidelity becomes available through what the attempt does, including its encounter with its own limit.

Here the source/appearance relation has two different offices within one whole. The singular One is unobjectifiable; the polyvalent All is the articulated field of appearances, differences and relations. Appearance appears in awareness, while awareness is encountered through appearing. This mutual relation does not make the two poles interchangeable objects or equal causal producers. In [the Two Ones](A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md), `0` names singular One and `1` polyvalent All, rather than two bare labels, “ground” and “mark.” The [Primordial Symbolon](A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) holds parent relation, six qualitative determinations and return-switch as one native sequence. The local defining act takes place within that field; naming its condition does not put the act outside it.

## #1

**We define God:** God is the whole that any coherent representational system participates in and necessarily fails to contain. In the [direct Definition of God manuscript](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md), this philosophical proposition relates representation to its own condition. A system's account can articulate that relation; the system does not thereby acquire a position outside everything that makes its articulation possible.

The definition's predicates already carry a predicament. The manuscript presses four received omni-attributes: omnipotence, omniscience, omnipresence and omnibenevolence. Each extends an unlimited vector through a domain—power, knowledge, presence and goodness. Yet the claimed unlimitedness puts each attribute at issue. A power unable to bind itself would be bounded by that inability. Omnipotence therefore includes real self-limitation; omniscience reaches the sealed blind spot; omnipresence includes genuine absence. The predicament must be actual. A freedom that only pretended to forget, while secretly retaining every answer in the finite life, would not have entered the limit it claims the freedom to make.

**Omnivalence** and **omni-lemmicity** complete the four in this authorial construction. Omnivalence names the condition from which the whole valence-field differentiates: generative and destructive, auspicious and terrible, light and shadow. Goodness and its negation lie within that differentiation; the ground is not assigned an equal portion of each by a measure placed outside it. Omni-lemmicity names the capacity of every predicate to become its own issue. Every fork, undecidable and self-obstacle is internal to the field of freedom. The four explicit attributes unfold an implicate pair: the full field of valence and the self-predicament through which any of its predicates can invert. This is the particular `4+2` the definition performs, not a count imposed on an arbitrary list.

Its freedom includes genuine limiting, forgetting and becoming its own obstacle. What was asserted as unlimited capacity returns as the finite aperture of a particular life: power as binding, knowledge as the blind spot, presence as abandonment, the full valence-field as this wound. The name can be broken and its image overthrown because the source is not exhausted by either. The predicates lead into the defining act's own undoing. This is the native philosophical argument; its force does not depend on treating the theological set as a formal system to which Gödel's theorems have already been applied.

The assertion gives us something definite to examine. It identifies the intended referent, distinguishes it from a further object in the field, and commits the speaker to consequences. [Determination](concepts/C03-Determination.md) cuts the field: to say what counts is also to establish what falls outside the count. [Constitutive Exclusion](A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) makes identity answer to those exclusions. An omitted condition does not cease to operate because the definition has omitted it.

The act also requires a name, an instance and a circumstance of identification. A name alone cannot determine what is being identified here. To count “one” already requires a discrimination, and to identify that one again requires a relation across difference. In Frank's protected encounter with [Kripke](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity.md), who identifies, what is identified, and in what circumstance cannot simply be subtracted from the name's use. This pressure beneath a polished account of naming is the author's derivational use of that encounter, not an attribution of QL or its counting architecture to Kripke.

The [copula](concepts/C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) identifies through a relation whose terms remain distinct. “God is…” has a speaker, an assertion and a referent whose relation the assertion undertakes. The words are already doing something. The first move becomes exact enough to encounter the consequences of what it does.

## #2

**We fail to define God.** “God is the indefinable” remains a determinate sentence. It marks a boundary, assigns a name and asks to count as a true account. The defining act has not escaped the relation it describes. The direct manuscript gives the image of a fish describing water while swimming in it: the description belongs to the very circumstance it seeks to make available.

The failure is precise. It is the failure of final enclosure. A representation of the condition of appearing appears again; an account of the present act becomes something that can be examined in a further present act. Refining the representation can deepen its truth without abolishing that difference. The [Immutable Gap](concepts/C05-Immutable-Gap.md) recurs through the gain in knowledge, while the [Formal Limit](concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) arises through the operation of inclusion itself rather than an arbitrary prohibition imposed on inquiry.

Self-reference generates the pressure internally. If the account claims completeness, it must include the conditions of its own determining. When it represents those conditions, the represented act and the act now representing it remain distinct. The attempt at closure renews the difference it meant to close. This is why the failure is informative: it identifies an office the account cannot assume while remaining an account.

Assertion and non-enclosure have different objects: one claims an intelligible relation; the other denies that the claim possesses its own condition. Their distinction permits exact, corrigible and transmissible knowledge. The [formal-limit operation](A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) keeps the present act distinct from what it represents, even when the represented conditions become more complete. Its mathematical and logical neighbours retain their own hypotheses; this operation does not turn every representation into a Gödelian formal system.

## #3

**We succeed because we fail.** The definition now includes the difference its own activity produces. It says what it can say and makes its non-exhaustion available within that saying. It performs the relation it names: a determinate account answering to what makes the account possible.

The direct manuscript's cage and window give this change its image. A closed image occupying the source-office is a cage where a window was needed. A window has a definite frame. Its opening depends on that frame without claiming that everything disclosed belongs inside it. The image is an internal figure of the operation, not an external proof. A [living symbol](concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) discloses through its achieved form; an idol promotes that form into possession of its source. Through [image and valuation](A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md), the same appropriation can make a world valuable and actionable while preventing its contradictory witness from changing the image.

What the definition cannot enclose is now operative in how it means. It can be binding without being final. It remains liable to correction by a renewed encounter rather than protecting itself against the condition it claims to name. The failure of capture gives the account a return route.

[Symbol / Account / Trust](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md) makes the relation answerable in use: a determinate Symbol discloses; an Account states how the disclosure answers to its source; Trust permits committed use with recourse through encounter, consequence and revision. These operations meet in faithful definition without establishing common philological descent among “God,” “Subject,” “definition,” “symbol,” “account” and “trust.” The account can guide action while keeping its source able to answer it.

Omnivalence becomes concrete through **lack**. Becoming reaches toward a satisfaction; each satisfaction is the perishing of that becoming into what it has achieved, which becomes a condition for a further act rather than final possession of the source of reaching. In the manuscript's operation, lack is the chargeless aperture from which particular valences arise. The direction of power gives the act its moral charge: **does it enslave and claim, or release and make free?** The availability of every valence makes the direction consequential. It does not excuse the enslaving choice. A finite person used as a means has been subjected to an actual act of possession; an account of the whole remains answerable for that act.

This brings the predicate's predicament into the life of a measure. A [complex's local arbitration](A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) can take its criterion for the whole; [usurpation of measure](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) occurs where that criterion's source and authority can no longer be questioned. The complex's local competence can survive return to the wider field. The power to release includes releasing a definition's claim to final jurisdiction without destroying its capacity to discriminate.

This also specifies fidelity's demand. Simply suspending every determination would leave nothing with which to act or answer. Faithful definition must risk a positive account and retain the means by which that account can change. Its success is the achieved relation, including the limit that keeps the relation alive.

## #4

**We neither succeed nor fail.** Success and failure, taken separately, each name only part of the activity now available. Assertion, failed enclosure and successful disclosure belong to one situated movement. What was sought as an entity standing still before the definition has disclosed the activity in which defining itself occurs.

The circumstance is no longer merely background. [Context and Context Frame](concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) retain the lived field and its selected representation as different offices; [mediation](concepts/C10-Mediation-Pramana.md) relates knower and known through the means of their encounter. The definition has a body, a history, a concern and someone for whom its truth matters. Through [diaphaneity](concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md), that determining circumstance becomes readable in its determinations. [Contextual transparency](A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) lets the account disclose how the situation of its making shaped what it says.

This completing fourth does not add a fourth pronoun beside I, you and it. Nor does it provide a spectator free of circumstance. It lets the relations among perspectives become available together. The author's encounters with [Singh's introduction to the Parātrīśikā-Vivaraṇa](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md) and [Gebser](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) sharpen this personed and contextual pressure through their own accounts. Their historical claims and passage readiness remain distinct from the native operation. Through [Vāk](A06-Vak.md), I and you become situated in address; through [Prakāśa–Vimarśa](A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md), appearing takes up its own activity in reflexive recognition.

Yet even this whole account still speaks **about** God. It says that the referent is a source, a limit, a dynamic or a context. It can accurately describe the involvement of the person defining and still describe that involvement from the position of an account. This is the exact asymmetry the next move must preserve. Context makes the turn possible; its description has not already performed the first-person recognition.

An elucidation can make its use and limits visible while the present defining act remains distinct from the successful account. In the [Formal Limit comparison](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md#native-definition-and-faith), the early Wittgenstein’s saying/showing distinction and Eckhart’s qualified predication open different external questions about that relation. Neither performs the person's first-person recognition on their behalf. These source-specific operations can sharpen the difference between account and present act without replacing the native sixfold.


## #5→0

The [eye's constitutive blindside](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-eye-condition) remains active through each disclosure of its conditions. A mirror or another observer can disclose a real condition of this view; the further disclosure remains situated. The resulting frame is useful precisely through what it selects and excludes. Recognition changes its claim to contain the source while keeping this finite act capable of answering.

Taylor’s [fish in water](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#fish-water) describes through the very element which sustains its activity: stepping outside that element would end the activity meant to describe it. The [cage–window transformation](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#cage-window) changes what the frame does. A definite frame can disclose what it cannot contain, and faithful definition retains that frame while releasing enclosure. In [the God-word’s speaking turn](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p16), the word points beyond the place a word can occupy. Words arise through difference; left and right run apart while mastering a span together. Symbolic number enters where words alone could not reach, and the coherent account includes its own release within saying. That speaking turn belongs to Taylor's poem; its polemical historical sequence retains a separate attribution task.

**I Am.** The utterance enters from within the activity whose condition the definition has tried to name. The one who was defining was always the one being defined. What appeared as the subject of a proposition is recognised as the Subject of the present act.

In the manuscript's God/Subject operation, this speaks **as** God from within rather than adding a final statement about God from outside. “God” names the source-condition; the recognition is of Present Being, not the construction of an image of a higher being. The utterance does not award a represented personality ownership of the whole. It changes the register of the inquiry: the source that could not be possessed as an object is present as the act undertaking the inquiry. In the [native subject sequence](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), first-, second- and third-person perspectives become available together, their unity is recognised, and that one returns as `0/1`. This fifth-position recognition inherits the contextual fourth and returns the capacity of relation. The broad theological comparisons are authorial readings, not a claim here that every named tradition teaches one verified doctrine.

The present I can describe its thoughts, habits, memories and self-image. Each description has a truth and an office. None contains the act now knowing it. Q27's distinction among selfing, the local self, the self-thing, Subjectivity and Self prevents this recognition from hardening into a new proprietor. In Frank's protected [Watson encounter](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness.md), selfing is an activity, and a person remains situated and addressable without being an independently existing self-thing. Exposing that fabrication leaves the experient present, while recognising the Subject does not restore the self-thing as an invisible owner.

The return is therefore to the capacity for further determination. Recognition does not abolish the names or the differences through which it became available. In [Mono–Poly](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones.md), singular One and polyvalent All remain one relation with different offices. The native sixfold has a concrete binary and binary-of-binary construction, `2 + 2² = 6`: [the Two Ones](A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) supply two terms, and [the complete determination field](A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) retains those terms and their four ordered pairings within parent and return. The six positions here enact definition specifically. Their local performance neither replaces the eight determinations nor makes them six universal glossary meanings.

Through [identification with difference](A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md), the personal circuit reaches “Am” through the relation that began in “is”; its identification is now staked from within without requiring exhaustive enclosure. [Trust and faith under formal limit](A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) carry that relation into use: [commitment](concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) remains possible without epistemic possession. In the [trust revision](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md), trust can be investigated, corrected, withdrawn and renewed. Fidelity does not guarantee harmlessness; an actual consequence can warrant withdrawal rather than continued exposure.

The consequences differentiate authority and address. A [derivative measure](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) usurps the source-office when its criterion can no longer answer to the field it judges; a [mediating office](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) can exercise real authority while remaining received from its source. [The Other](A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) can answer beyond my model: inclusion in the whole does not make another person a possession of me. First-person recognition leaves these relations and their differences active.

[Objective Internality](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) makes the technical relation more exact. A local interpreting agent can occupy the functional knower office of the assertions it judges. Its retained source, memory, comparison rules, tools and selected context mediate that judgment; the assertions and their discrepancies form its known field. Within the person's inquiry, the complete apparatus belongs among the means by which a definition becomes answerable. A further inspection can make the local centre and its self-description known without making the first-person condition of that inspection another described component. The same distinction holds in human encounter: another person's first-person presence is not the final object a sufficiently complete description will capture.

Consider a definition-checking task. A discrepancy between an assertion and the actual source can warrant correction of the assertion under an adequate fidelity rule. If the rule excludes contrary source evidence, that rule and its judging authority must themselves become available for correction. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons; the next judgment inherits the warranted correction or retention. This constructed operation makes constituted means, performed selfhood and functional agency effective within a world of relation. Through [order of dependence](A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md), the local determining centre remains related to the containing Life rather than becoming a final spectator outside it.

At the essay's far return, [Integral Zero](A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) lets a mathematical sign disclose as Symbol without ceasing to be sign. This remains possible because the first relation has not been discarded: a determination can disclose more than it exhausts. Every renewed account returns to the presence within which it is made, exact enough to answer and open enough to be answered.

[Job's address](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-native-return) can speak truthfully from the suffered particular without possessing the council's account of him; the whirlwind changes the field in which his speech answers. The positive return is a determinate address whose fidelity remains open to encounter, rather than a definition made faithful by ceasing to say anything. The council's concealed information is a narrative asymmetry; it does not by itself supply the native act/content limit.

In [the Village's asymmetric count](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-asymmetric-count), the speaking subject exceeds the predicate assigned to him. The Village answers a question about Number One by designating its interlocutor Number Six: the person is counted while the authority of the count is withheld. His first-person refusal keeps the source-question active. The return concerns what definition can truthfully determine without taking possession of the one who speaks; Number One is not a narrative identity for native Zero.

### Provenance, routing and remaining restoration

The performed sequence returns every definition to the act by which it is made. Predicate, self-predicament, contextual fourth and first-person fifth therefore belong to one movement: the account becomes faithful where its own implication is no longer left outside what it says.

The direct *Definition of God — Draft 3*, the core theorem and the developed self/Subject distinctions articulate this movement at different depths. A naming problem sharpens identification; a selfing critique distinguishes the local person from a fabricated proprietor; contextual transparency makes the situation of determination readable. Their historical and comparative accounts retain the particular operations through which they meet the performed definition.

First-person presence is the condition through which every determinate account appears. Faithful definition includes its determining activity in what it means, risking a positive claim while keeping that claim answerable to what it names. The cut makes the account exact; its gift makes a further answer possible. The resulting order of dependence retains this presence through the means of inquiry and the world which becomes known.

The source relations used here remain distinct:

| Core theorem spine | **Paraphrased** native derivation: whole eightfold and local performed sixfold. External mathematical claims retain their hypotheses. |
| Revision notes on trust | **Paraphrased** internal development; labelled authorial corrections remain distinct from mixed dialogue. |

The predicate's self-predicament carries into inversion and return: a completed account becomes a condition of another determination, while [the Spanda equations](../../symbolon/matheme/spanda/spanda-equations.md) preserve relation, standing unity and renewed organisation as different operations. In [Job's encounter](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-jung-second-whole), the suffered witness and the friends' changed authority belong to the biblical telling; Jung's God-image confronting its own contradiction belongs to his separately attributed reception. Both keep an achieved account answerable through encounter, without converting omnivalence into a claim that harm has no moral direction. A [local psychic criterion](A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and an [arbitral measure](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) retain their capacity to judge when they can answer for the source, exclusions and consequence of that judgment.
